text: Did you know if you soak one cup of red lentils
in water for three hours, add a pinch of salt
Pour a ladle into a hot skillet
and cook for two minutes on each side
and you end up with soft wraps that fold like a tortilla,
made from one ingredient, zero flour, zero eggs, zero dairy.
That feeds the good bacteria in your gut
and they carry enough plant protein
to keep you full for hours.
Without the blood sugar crash you get from bread.
I share real recipes to boost your health,
help with bloating, brain fog, immunity
Comment yes if you want more like this
and follow me so you don't miss the next one.
